summary: M22 Phase 1 implements three intelligent learning pipelines: import learning (CAP-001), self-evolving writing (CAP-002), and reading learning (CAP-003). Shared interfaces and knowledge layer integration enable parallel pipeline development in a single phase.
approach: Create src-ts/learning/ module with shared types and orchestration infrastructure first, then implement three independent pipelines in parallel, expose via MCP endpoints, and validate with ≥80% test coverage. All pipelines integrate with existing GraphManager, KnowledgeService, DistillationService, and the 30-dimensional StyleSystem — no modifications to existing public interfaces.

data_flow.diagram: Input documents/chapters → ExtractionUtils → Pipeline (Import|Writing|Reading) → KnowledgeService/GraphManager/StyleSystem → MCP endpoint → Desktop

design_decisions: All learning code lives in src-ts/learning/ — no modifications to existing module public interfaces.
Shared interfaces (ILearningPipeline, IExtractionResult) enable DI container per-pipeline enable/disable.
ImportLearningPipeline reuses existing StyleSystem's 30-dimensional vector for style extraction.
SelfEvolvingWritingAgent uses Generator-Reflector-Curator pattern from ACE reference with evidence-threshold rule evolution.
ReadingLearningPipeline uses SpoilerGate chapter-gating with light/heavy extraction tiers from marginalia reference.
MCP endpoints follow existing per-feature file pattern in src-ts/mcp/endpoints/.

patterns: DI registration: bindSingleton<T>(ServiceTypes.Symbol, () => new Impl(config)) in container/bindings.ts
MCP endpoints: per-feature files with named exports, barrel re-exported from index.ts
Style system: StyleDimension enum with 30 dimensions in narrative/style-system.ts
Distillation: DistillationTemplate enum + DistillationManager in memory/distillation-manager.ts
Knowledge layer: IKnowledgeService (addDocument, addEntity, addRelation, search, distillKnowledge) in container/types.ts
conventions: Enum + interface + Record pattern for extensible type-safe registries
Service types as Symbol.for('Name') in container/types.ts ServiceTypes object
MCP endpoint handlers use HttpRequest/HttpResponse from mcp/http-types
Tests use Vitest with describe/it/expect in src-ts/tests/
dependencies: src-ts/container/types.ts — ServiceTypes symbols and service interfaces
src-ts/mcp/endpoints/index.ts — barrel exports for endpoint discovery
src-ts/graph/graph-manager.ts — graph storage for entity/relation persistence

tasks.title: Create learning module shared types
tasks.description: Define all shared types, interfaces, and enums for the learning module: LearningCapability enum, ILearningPipeline interface, IExtractionResult, IStyleFeature, IEntityExtraction, IWorldviewElement, IInsight, IStyleRule, IStyleDriftReport, ISpoilerGate, PipelineStatus enum, LearningConfig type.
acceptance: LearningCapability enum with IMPORT, SELF_EVOLVING, READING values
ILearningPipeline interface with execute(), getStatus(), enable(), disable() methods
IExtractionResult generic interface with entities, styleFeatures, worldviewElements
IStyleFeature interface matching 30-dimensional StyleDimension vector
IStyleRule with evidence threshold and evolution metadata
ISpoilerGate with chapter gating and light/heavy extraction tiers
All types exported from src-ts/learning/index.ts barrel

tasks.title: Create shared extraction utilities
tasks.description: Implement shared text extraction utilities used by all three pipelines: document parsing (TXT/MD/PDF/DOCX), text segmentation, entity extraction helpers, style feature calculation from existing StyleSystem, and worldview element detection.
acceptance: parseDocument() handles TXT, MD, PDF (via pdf-parse), DOCX (via mammoth)
segmentText() splits into paragraphs/chapters with metadata preservation
extractEntities() returns IEntityExtraction[] using existing KnowledgeService patterns
calculateStyleFeatures() leverages existing StyleSystem's 30-dimensional analysis
detectWorldviewElements() identifies world-building components
All functions are pure/stateless — no side effects, suitable for parallel pipeline use

tasks.title: Create learning orchestrator
tasks.description: Implement LearningOrchestrator that coordinates pipeline execution, manages pipeline lifecycle (enable/disable per pipeline), and provides unified status reporting. Coordinates with existing KnowledgeService and GraphManager.
acceptance: LearningOrchestrator accepts ILearningPipeline[] and manages their lifecycle
enable/disable per LearningCapability controls which pipelines are active
getStatus() returns unified status across all active pipelines
Integrates with IKnowledgeService for knowledge storage and retrieval
Integrates with IGraphEngine for entity/relation graph operations
Thread-safe: concurrent pipeline execution supported

tasks.title: Register learning services in DI container
tasks.description: Add LearningOrchestrator and three pipeline service types to the DI container. Follow existing bindSingleton pattern. Each pipeline independently enable/disable via config.
acceptance: ServiceTypes gains LearningOrchestrator, ImportLearning, SelfEvolvingWriting, ReadingLearning symbols
registerCanonicalBindings() updated with new bindSingleton entries
Each pipeline resolves its dependencies (KnowledgeService, GraphEngine, etc.) from container
ILearningOrchestrator interface added to types.ts
Existing service registrations unchanged — only additive changes

tasks.title: Implement Import Learning Pipeline (CAP-001)
tasks.description: Implement ImportLearningPipeline: accepts document input (TXT/MD/PDF/DOCX), parses via ExtractionUtils, extracts entities/style/worldview, distills via DistillationManager, and writes structured knowledge to GraphManager. Full pipeline: DocumentParser → EntityExtractor → StyleExtractor → WorldviewExtractor → DistillationPipeline → GraphManager.
acceptance: processDocument(filePath) accepts all supported formats and returns IExtractionResult
Entity extraction identifies characters, locations, organizations, items
Style extraction produces 30-dimensional IStyleFeature vector
Worldview extraction identifies rules, settings, cultural elements
Results persisted via IKnowledgeService.addDocument/addEntity/addRelation
Progress reporting via ILearningPipeline.getStatus()
Error handling: malformed documents, unsupported formats return graceful failures

tasks.title: Implement Self-Evolving Writing Agent (CAP-002)
tasks.description: Implement SelfEvolvingWritingAgent with Generator-Reflector-Curator pattern. RuleEvolver manages evidence-threshold style rule evolution (threshold ≥3). PreferenceTracker tracks user preferences over time. StyleDriftDetector detects and reports style divergence.
acceptance: SelfEvolvingWritingAgent implements ILearningPipeline with Generator-Reflector-Curator loop
RuleEvolver.accumulateEvidence() collects feedback; evolves rule when evidence count ≥3
RuleEvolver tracks rule version history with before/after snapshots
PreferenceTracker records user preference signals (accept/reject/modify actions)
StyleDriftDetector.compare() detects drift between current and baseline style vectors
StyleDriftDetector.report() produces IStyleDriftReport with severity and suggestions
Integration with existing StyleSystem for vector comparison

tasks.title: Implement Reading Learning Pipeline (CAP-003)
tasks.description: Implement ReadingLearningPipeline with chapter-gated extraction. SpoilerGate controls light/heavy extraction tiers based on reading progress. InsightDistiller follows 6-stage marginalia pipeline. CrossReference supports cross-book knowledge linking.
acceptance: ReadingLearningPipeline implements ILearningPipeline
SpoilerGate.gate(chapterRead, chapterTarget) returns allowed extraction tier (light|heavy|blocked)
Light extraction: summary, key entities, tone — no plot revelations
Heavy extraction: full analysis including plot, themes, character arcs
InsightDistiller follows 6-stage pipeline: capture → annotate → connect → question → synthesize → distill
CrossReference.link(sourceBook, targetBook) creates cross-book knowledge edges in GraphManager
Session tracking preserves reading position for resumable analysis

tasks.title: Add learning MCP endpoints
tasks.description: Add four MCP endpoints for learning capabilities: POST /import/learn, POST /writing/evolve, POST /reading/learn, GET /learning/status. Follow existing per-feature endpoint pattern with barrel export.
acceptance: POST /import/learn accepts {filePath, options?} and triggers ImportLearningPipeline
POST /writing/evolve accepts {action, content, feedback?} for SelfEvolvingWritingAgent
POST /reading/learn accepts {bookId, chapter, content} for ReadingLearningPipeline
GET /learning/status returns unified status from LearningOrchestrator
learning.ts exports named handlers following writing-craft.ts pattern
index.ts barrel updated with re-exports from learning.ts
All endpoints use parseBody/jsonResponse from http-types

tasks.title: Integration tests

acceptance: DI container resolves all learning services correctly
Import pipeline processes a test TXT file through full extraction → storage flow
Self-evolving agent accumulates evidence and evolves a style rule
Reading pipeline respects SpoilerGate tiers and produces distilled insights
MCP endpoints return correct HTTP responses with expected payload shapes
LearningOrchestrator enable/disable controls pipeline availability

tasks.title: Unit tests for ≥80% coverage
tasks.description: Comprehensive unit tests for all learning module components targeting ≥80% coverage. Tests cover extraction logic, pipeline state machines, rule evolution, spoiler gating, and edge cases.
acceptance: All extraction-utils functions tested with various input formats
Import pipeline tested with mock documents (TXT, MD)
RuleEvolver tested: evidence accumulation, threshold triggering, version history
PreferenceTracker tested: signal recording, preference aggregation
SpoilerGate tested: all tier transitions, edge cases (chapter 0, beyond end)
